name: io.github.rudraptpsingh/figbridge
description: Free, local MCP bridge for Figma — HTML, CSS, Tailwind, tokens, agent handoff bundles.

environmentVariables.name: FIGBRIDGE_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Preferred TCP port for the local HTTP+SSE bridge the Figma plugin connects to (default 7331). If unset and the port is busy, the bridge tries 7332–7340. If the port is already held by another figbridge-mcp, this process attaches to it (shared bridge) instead of taking the next port — set the same value in every MCP client (Cursor, Codex, Claude) so they all use one Live bridge.
